name: Marquis One
overview: Marquis One by Marquis Point is a landmark residential development redefining upscale urban living in Arjan, Dubailand. With its bold architectural design, expansive layouts, and smart living integration, this 28-storey tower is engineered to provide a lifestyle of convenience, wellness, and luxury. Whether you're a young professional or a growing family, Marquis One offers tailored residences in a vibrant, well-connected community, complete with premium amenities and panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline. It represents a rare fusion of modern design, intelligent living, and investment potential in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing areas.
